You have seen it

That tree is not getting any straighter

Every yard has one. The oak leaning a little closer to the roof every year. The dead limb hanging over the driveway. The pine that sways harder than the rest when the wind picks up.

Leaning Trees

A lean that grows is a root system giving up. By the time it falls, it picks the target: the roof, the car, the fence, the power line.

Dead Limbs

Dead wood does not announce itself. It drops on calm days too, and one limb through a windshield or a roof costs more than taking the tree down right.

Storm Damage

Split trunks, hung up limbs and trees already on the ground. Dangerous work that needs a trained crew and the right equipment, not a ladder and a borrowed saw.

So the only question is: does it come down on your schedule, or the storm's?

The Work

Everything a tree needs.
Or needs gone.

Full service tree work for Henderson, from the first cut to the last load of debris hauled away.

  • 01

    Tree Removal

    Whole trees taken down safely, piece by piece when space is tight, and hauled off your property.

  • 02

    Tree Cutting

    Felling and cutting work done by a trained crew with the right saws, ropes and rigging.

  • 03

    Trimming and Pruning

    Dead, crowded and overhanging limbs cut back so the tree grows strong and stays off your roof.

  • 04

    Stump Grinding

    Stumps ground out below the surface so you can mow, plant and use the yard again.

  • 05

    Debris Hauling

    Limbs, logs and brush loaded and hauled away. Your yard is left clean, not covered in the job.

  • 06

    Shrub Trimming

    Shrubs shaped and cut back to keep beds neat and walkways clear.

  • 07

    Mulch and Pine Straw

    Fresh mulch and pine straw laid down to finish the beds and protect the roots.

  • 08

    Disease Spraying

    Trees sprayed for disease to protect the healthy ones you want to keep.
